bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
W="$HOME/.cache/gace-posting-baseline-20261113"
test -d "$W" || exit 31
docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$W/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:posting-baseline-20261113 "$W" >/tmp/gace-posting-baseline-build-hostnet.log 2>&1 || exit 33
LIVE=$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local /app/gaybbs.mjs | awk '{print $1}')
BASE=$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:posting-baseline-20261113 /app/gaybbs.mjs | awk '{print $1}')
MATCH=false; test "$LIVE" = "$BASE" && MATCH=true
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "GAYBBS_RUNTIME_BASELINE_HOSTNET_20261113 live_bundle_equals_checkedout_head=$MATCH" >/dev/null || true
test "$MATCH" = true || exit 34
echo GAYBBS_RUNTIME_BASELINE_MATCH_PASS
